sentences.en: No public education existed in India before the British colonization.
sentences.zh: 在英国殖民之前，印度没有公共教育。

sentences.en: Colonization of other planets is one of our top priorities.
sentences.zh: 其他星球的殖民是我们最重要的优先事项之一。

sentences.en: Algerians were able to break the yoke of French colonization.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚人能够摆脱法国殖民的枷锁。
